title: Use the Desired Output
text: The output should contain one full field at a time, such as $$species=tyrannosaurusrex$$, $$name=Rexy$$, and $$id=5884nngh$$. The commas are separators and should not be included in the captured output.

title: First Field to Capture
text: From rex\_string, what should the first captured field be?

title: Allow an Optional Comma Separator
text: After the first field, each new field starts right after a comma. The comma should be matched so the regex can move between fields, but it should stay outside the capturing group so it is not returned.

title: Avoid Greedy or Overly Broad Matches
text: A pattern like .* or \S+ can capture too much because it can keep going through commas. The correct pattern should stop each match after one field-value pair.

title: Avoid the Character-Class Trap
text: In [species|name|id], the brackets create a character class, not a choice between the words species, name, and id. That means it matches one character from the set, not the full field names.
